alignment_move.description: One step of a conformance-checking alignment between log and model.

move_type.description: One of: sync | model | log | silent.

cost.description: Non-negative cost assigned to this move.

case_stats.description: Aggregate statistics computed for one process instance (case).

event_count.description: Number of events observed for this case.

duration_seconds.description: Optional case duration in seconds (end minus start).

conformance_result.description: Conformance-checking metrics computed for one trace against a model.

trace_id.description: Identifier of the trace this result was computed for.

dfg_edge.description: One frequency-annotated directly-follows edge between two activities.

frequency.description: Observed occurrence count of this edge.

event_log.description: A named collection of events forming one process-mining log.

description.description: Optional free-text description of this log.

event_type.description: A declared OCEL event type and its attribute schema.

attribute_names.description: Optional declared attribute names for events of this type (name-only; per-attribute value types are not yet modeled).

heuristic_arc.description: One dependency-scored candidate arc considered during heuristic-net discovery.

dependency_measure.description: The computed dependency/confidence score for this candidate arc.

k8s_object_ref.description: A reference to one Kubernetes object observed in the runtime topology.

kind.description: The Kubernetes object kind (e.g. Pod, Deployment).

namespace.description: Optional object namespace (absent for cluster-scoped kinds such as Node, PersistentVolume, ClusterRole, or Namespace itself).

log_trace.description: One case-centric trace: an ordered activity sequence for a single case.

case_id.description: Identifier of the case this trace belongs to.

activity_sequence.description: Ordered list of activity names observed for this case.

object_attribute_change.description: One recorded change to a time-indexed object attribute.

object_id.description: Identifier of the object whose attribute changed.

old_value.description: Optional previous value (absent if this is the first recorded value).

new_value.description: The new value after the change.

changed_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp the change took effect.

object_type.description: A declared OCEL object type and its attribute schema.

attribute_names.description: Optional declared attribute names for objects of this type (name-only; per-attribute value types are not yet modeled).

oc_declare_constraint.description: One declarative object-centric behavioral constraint between two activities.

constraint_type.description: One of: response | precedence | succession | non_coexistence (standard DECLARE constraint template names).

ocel_attribute.description: One named, timestamped attribute value on an OCEL event or object.

attribute_value.description: The attribute value, serialized as a string.

recorded_at.description: Optional ISO8601 timestamp this value was recorded/became effective.

ocel_event.description: An OCEL 2.0 event: one recorded occurrence in an object-centric log.

ocel_object.description: An OCEL 2.0 object: one entity participating in the process.

attributes.description: Arbitrary named current attribute values (a flat snapshot, not the time-indexed history -- see bpm:ocel_attribute and bpm:object_attribute_change for per-timestamp values).

ocel_relationship.description: A qualified relationship linking an event or object to an object.

path_schema.description: One reusable, scored connection pattern between two OCEL types.

support.description: Observed instance count supporting this schema.

path_schema_query.description: A discovery query bounding source/target types and maximum schema length.

max_length.description: Maximum number of hops to search.

petri_arc.description: A weighted arc connecting a place and a transition (either direction).

source_id.description: Identifier of the arc's source node.

target_id.description: Identifier of the arc's target node.

petri_place.description: A place in a Petri net, holding a non-negative token count.

tokens.description: Current token count (marking) at this place.

petri_transition.description: A transition in a Petri net.

label.description: Optional human-readable/activity label (silent transition if absent).

planning_action.description: One PDDL-style planning action with its preconditions and effects.

preconditions.description: Optional list of precondition fact names.

effects.description: Optional list of effect fact names this action produces.

planning_state.description: One planning-search state as a bounded set of true facts.

facts.description: List of fact names true in this state.

policy_decision.description: One admission/authority policy decision recorded for an attempted action.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for this verdict.

process_variant.description: One distinct activity-sequence variant observed in a log, with its frequency.

activity_sequence.description: Ordered list of activity names making up this variant.

frequency.description: Number of traces observed with exactly this activity sequence.

queue_snapshot.description: One point-in-time observation of a queue depth.

depth.description: Observed queue depth at this point in time.

resource_allocation.description: One recorded assignment of a resource to an activity occurrence.

activity.description: The activity the resource was assigned to.

event_id.description: Identifier of the specific event occurrence.

service_span.description: One OpenTelemetry-style tracing span observed for a service call.

service_name.description: Name of the service that produced this span.

parent_span_id.description: Optional identifier of the parent span.

sojourn_time.description: The total dwell/duration time an object was associated with one event/activity (object-centric sojourn time -- a duration metric, distinct from bpm:sync_time's wait-for-another-object metric).

object_id.description: Identifier of the object this measurement is for.

event_type.description: The event type/activity this sojourn measurement is at.

sync_time.description: The time one object waited to synchronize with another object at a shared event.

object_id.description: Identifier of the object this measurement is for.

delaying_object_id.description: Optional identifier of the object that caused the delay.

type_edge.description: A directed, qualified edge in the OCEL type graph between two types.

qualifier.description: The relationship qualifier/role name for this edge.
